lines: With cow-dung he should make the form, disciple-like, should place; then in it one path to be purified, from the contemplation of pervasion.
l4.sanskrit_cite: gomayenākṛtiṃ kuryācchiṣyavattāṃ nidhāpayet tatastasyāṃ śodhyamekamadhvānaṃ vyāptibhāvanāt
